# Some inspiration

- `epinowcast`. A community forum and a seminar series, where people who
  did not write the code answer each other. 144 members, 1,273 posts, and
  34 seminars since May 2023
- `Turing.jl`. Small packages that other people build on, rather than one
  library
- `SciML`. Shared interfaces, and downstream CI run against packages it
  does not own
- `rOpenSci`. Software peer review and a written package guide. Julia has
  nothing like it
- `SpeedyWeather.jl`, `Comrade.jl`, `HydroModels.jl`. One domain each,
  done properly
